plannedSources.conditions: Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes . They can be mined with a pickaxe or drill . Ice Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions. This effect can be mitigated by equipping Ice Skates or other accessories crafted from them.

plannedSources.conditions: The Lichen Stone Wall , Leafy Jungle Wall , Ivy Stone Wall , and Jungle Vine Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Jungle , considered unsafe . They do not drop as an item when destroyed, and can only be obtained on the Desktop , Console , and Mobile , via crafting. They are considered safe walls when placed by the player.
